findings.evidence: Roadmap lines 694–697 say “Name the two restriction maps to the intersection explicitly”; lines 103–109 contain only inline applications, and `rg -n "restrictNormalHomOfLE"` finds no concrete polynomial restriction-map definitions.
findings.fix: Add two public `Polynomial.Gal` definitions for the restrictions from `p.Gal` and `q.Gal` to the common intersection, give them characteristic lemmas as needed, and state this theorem using those definitions.
findings.issue: The fibre-product theorem embeds both restriction maps as long `restrictNormalHomOfLE` expressions, so consumers cannot refer to either canonical map by name despite the roadmap explicitly requiring both maps to be named.

summary: The polynomial API still does not explicitly name the two restriction maps required by the roadmap; it only expands generic constructions inline.
